desc: Imports OTP tokens from RFC 6030 XML file
r: ipa-otptoken-import - Imports OTP tokens from RFC 6030 XML file

Running the command will attempt to import all tokens specified in infile. If the command is unable to import a token, the reason for the failure will be printed to standard error and all failed tokens will be written to the outfile for further inspection.

If the infile contains encrypted token data, then the keyfile (-k) option MUST be specified.

-k keyfile, --keyfile=keyfile
File containing the key used to decrypt the token data.

0 if the command was successful

1 if an error occurred
